_._: page — the proposal form as structure: what each position of a proposal's spine becomes on the page. Each line opens with the component the assembler draws (a word from the law's vocabulary), then says it for a mind. The digits are the spine's own digits; no family's name appears here, so one form serves every proposal.
_.1: summary — where it stands: every decision down the spine, its answers counted by their first word, each a link to its card

1._: section — a step: its title before ' — ' as the heading, the rest as its lead
1.1: next — the following step, set after this one on the page, in this same form (sequence is depth in the block and a sequence on the page)
1.2: room — a side-room, closed until opened: its title before ' — ' as the label, the rest inside
1.8: decision — the step's decision as a card: the question, whom it waits on, and every mirror's answer at this same address, its first word as a mark
1.9: state — the step's STATE once the work runs, as a capsule beside its heading

2: hidden — the root's 2 names the page itself; nothing to draw
3: room — where the proposal came from
9: footer — the provenance, small, at the foot
